variants.headline: Looking back: accident at a workplace
variants.sub: The colony has had an accident at a workplace.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: An accident had occurred at a workplace in {colony}.

A workplace accident warrants management attention without an invented estimate of liability or lost output. The event, its cause and any legal finding are distinct subjects. A disciplined assessment should take safety seriously while avoiding a financial calculation or an attribution of fault unsupported by the particulars supplied here.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We defend {target} against automatic blame. The fact of an accident does not by itself establish a breach or settle responsibility, and a fair account should resist treating a feared explanation as proven.
